theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (h : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), A ⊆ M → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → AEMeasurable h ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : Eucl P // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ∧ ∫⁻ x in A, h x * ‖nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : Eucl P // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
